children: A minor explosion injured two people at a plant run by Czech firearm and ammunition manufacturer Colt CZ Group's
Sellier & Bellot unit, Colt CZ said on Wednesday, adding the impact on production was marginal.
Colt CZ said it was investigating the incident that took place in an isolated area of the factory where primers are inserted into cartridge cases.
Colt CZ added one of the injured had been discharged from hospital. It did not give details on the condition of the other person.
